articles.title: Show HN: CLI Security for Agentic Development
articles.summary: The article describes 'badvibes', a new command-line tool for auditing software repositories. It specifically scans AI-assisted codebases for common issues, like missing essential configuration files. This tool then generates a 'Vibe Score' (0-100), helping developers identify and rectify potential 'AI slop'. Its aim is to enhance the quality and integrity of projects developed using AI assistance.

articles.title: Jewellers latch on to PM’s call for recycling, curb imports of gold
articles.summary: Leading Indian jewellers are aligning with Prime Minister Modi's push to curb gold imports. They plan to encourage customers to exchange old jewellery for new designs, rather than making fresh purchases. This strategy aims to reduce India's import bill for the precious metal, thereby strengthening the rupee and contributing to national economic stability by managing demand effectively.

articles.title: Long before Tejas, how India’s indigenous fighter jet Marut met a painful death that still haunts India today
articles.summary: India's HF-24 Marut, its first domestically designed and produced jet fighter, was a monumental achievement. Its induction made India the first Asian nation outside Russia to operationally field an indigenous combat jet. This highlighted India's early aerospace engineering prowess and commitment to defence self-reliance, paving the way for future domestic projects.
